visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with reddish-brown hair, wearing a green sleeveless high-neck top and light-wash jeans, sits on a brown sofa between two young boys. The boy on the left wears glasses and a light-striped shirt; the boy on the right wears a blue striped shirt. They are in an indoor setting with a white tiled wall background. (2) Graphic overlays appear on screen featuring Chinese characters for a Hakka language quiz, alongside cartoon icons of a bat and a witch. The woman gestures with her hands while the boys look at their whiteboards. (3) The camera uses split-screen and fast cuts to show the boys' reactions. The boy on the left holds a white board with handwritten numbers. The boy on the right smiles broadly. Colorful confetti graphics burst across the screen. (4) A screen recording of a Facebook page titled '新北市客家局' is displayed, showing various posts about Hakka food, culture, and events. (5) The woman is shown playing a large wooden grand piano in a brightly lit room. Pink floral graphics frame the edges of the screen. She wears the same green top and jeans. (6) In the final phase, the woman poses next to the piano, resting her arm on it. Text overlays and an image of the Hakka Museum building appear at the bottom of the frame.
